recipe.visualDefinition: A vertically split composition featuring a stark white upper half with centered serif typography and a lower half containing a cinematic portrait of three individuals against a vibrant blue studio backdrop.
coreVisualRelationships: Strict 50/50 horizontal division between white space and photographic content
Central vertical alignment of all typographic elements
Contrast between the clinical white top and the saturated blue bottom
Triangular arrangement of the three subjects in the lower frame
coreInvariants: High-key white negative space in the top half
Subjects wearing denim or textured blue-toned clothing
Thin horizontal lines underlining specific text elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects occupy the bottom 40% of the frame, centered horizontally with the middle figure slightly larger and more prominent.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central female figure's face acts as the primary focal point, anchored by the blue field.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the centered title in the white space, moves down to the central figure, then scans left and right to the supporting band members.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant white space in the top half creates a sense of airiness and focuses attention on the text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the lower half contrasted against zero saturation in the upper half.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to white, blue, and natural skin tones

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight for horizontal underlines
characterSpecificRedesigns: Numerical '2' is smaller and centered between two lines of text
Horizontal rules placed precisely under the top and bottom text lines
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different scales and cases for consistency.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast serif look of late 80s design.
Provides the classical proportions seen in the display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a split-screen image. The top half is solid off-white with a slight paper texture. The bottom half is a studio portrait of three people (one woman center, two men flanking) against a solid cobalt blue background. They are dressed in 1980s denim jackets. Lighting is soft but directional.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered black serif text in the upper white section. Use all caps for the first and third lines, with a smaller number in the middle. Add thin horizontal lines directly beneath the top and bottom words. Add a small, lowercase serif word at the very bottom center of the entire composition.

verificationChecks: Is the image split exactly in the middle?
Is the blue background a solid, saturated studio color?

mustRedesign: Remove all logos and branding stickers
postGenerationChecks: Verify serif font has high contrast
Ensure no text overlaps the blue section
Confirm horizontal rules are thin and black
recipe.reuseFormula: Split-screen composition [Top: White/Text] + [Bottom: Blue/Portrait] + Centered Serif Typography + Horizontal Rules.
